summary: Map WorldPop population exposed to a selected hazard and retain its severity
description:
Loads one hazard snapshot and one WorldPop population year over the requested area, then calls the population_exposure_by_hazard process. Hazard categories 1-4 are exposed, 0 is unexposed, and cells outside 0-4 or without data are missing. Severity is resampled to the WorldPop grid with nearest-neighbour resampling inside that process.

Publishes ONE variable per run (`variable`) as a GeoZarr dataset. The output_dataset_id must have a registered static dataset template whose `variable` matches (see population_exposure.yaml): one for exposed_population, one for hazard_severity.

Zarr output cannot be produced synchronously, so run this as a batch job (POST /jobs, then POST /jobs/{id}/results). Use one date for hazard_temporal_extent and one year for population_temporal_extent.

parameters.name: hazard_dataset_id
parameters.description: Published single-variable hazard dataset, for example dry_spell_hazard.

parameters.name: hazard_temporal_extent
parameters.description: A single hazard snapshot as [date, date].

parameters.name: population_temporal_extent
parameters.description: The WorldPop year to use as [start-of-year, end-of-year], for example ["2020-01-01", "2020-12-31"].

parameters.name: spatial_extent
parameters.description: Area to process, as a west/east/south/north bounding box in EPSG:4326 unless crs is given.

parameters.name: population_dataset_id
parameters.description: Population collection to use. Defaults to WorldPop global2 at 100 m.

parameters.name: variable
parameters.description: Which variable to publish. Must match the `variable` of the template registered for output_dataset_id.

parameters.name: output_dataset_id
parameters.description: ID of the dataset to publish. A static dataset template with this id and a matching `variable` must be registered on the instance.
